verdict.rationale: Mirrors is a developer tool that injects corrections into the customer's own production agents. The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside Mirrors that users can delegate tasks to. The mention that 'you or your coding agent' write corrections refers to the user's external agent, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
